verdict.rationale: Kino AI runs an MCP server that coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor connect to, so choosing install scope is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions installing or configuring it per project (repo-committed config) versus user-globally. Agents can connect to the MCP server, and projects open the same on any machine because clips stream from Kino, but neither is an install-scope choice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects
